source.name: Atlanta United: 'Emory Healthcare Named Founding Partner of AMB Sports and Entertainment'
source.quote: Emory Healthcare’s logo will be featured on the sleeve of Atlanta United’s kits
source.note: Announced as the club's 'Kit Patch Partner' debuting in the 2025 season; the 2026 release says Emory returns for a second year. End date and value were not disclosed.
